sub:dibasic-acid.label: Dibasic acid (DBA flakes)
sub:dibasic-acid.expert_note: Byproduct dicarboxylic acid mixture (adipic/glutaric/succinic) from adipic acid manufacture; traded as DBA flakes or liquid for polyester polyols, DBE solvents, and coatings.

sub:tetrahydrofuran.label: Tetrahydrofuran
sub:tetrahydrofuran.expert_note: Pure THF (2932.11) is a liquid cyclic ether solvent/monomer; flaked solid form in commercial catalogs often denotes downstream PTMEG (3907.29) for spandex.
